result.summary: A bounded, zero-experiment, zero-network, non-batch internal algebraic-derivation task on H-CREP-001's pair-product generators, the frozen P1553 instance model (deck sizes B in {2,3}, six strata), and the eight frozen EXP-CREP-001 route packages. Path A (trigger_found) was not reached: the only pairwise combination rule actually specified anywhere in the corpus (label-matching set union over deck0 x deck1 pairs) is trivially additive/telescoping but does not by itself determine z_R, since extendibility also requires an unspecified fold-in against decks 2, 3, and 4. Path B (obstruction_found) was reached: all eight frozen route packages represent that fold-in as a single, non-decomposed online step, the frozen preprocessing vocabulary supplies a dedicated compact pairwise object for exactly one deck pair (0-1) and none for any other, and the verifier's own max-style cost-aggregation rule makes this single undecomposed step alone sufficient to force the measured Theta(B^3) online floor -- explaining, mechanically and not by restatement, why ROUTE-04-multipoint-evaluation and ROUTE-07-subresultant-hgcd fail despite their own algebra-specific steps genuinely being quasi-linear relative to the object they are handed. This obstruction claim was checked against docs/inventor-protocol.md Section 8's four audits, including a fresh proves-too-much control against the same subproduct-tree/known-linear-factors nearby object used in the prior gate-framing-review round, and passes on directly-inspectable structural grounds (graph decomposition levels; a frozen vocabulary dictionary; a frozen aggregation formula) rather than on the asserted, definitional premise about r_R's abstract identity that the Coordinator's own independent review found insufficient in the prior round -- the specific gap this task was dispatched to close. A genuine, honestly-disclosed residual gap remains (whether a hypothetical interleaved, modulus-reduced combination rule for decks 2-4 could succeed) and is carried forward as forward guidance, not smoothed into an implied impossibility claim. No B71, experiment, implementation, scientific transition, attack, speedup, novelty, closure, support, completion, or breakthrough claim is made. H-CREP-001's status and EXP-CREP-001's specification are unchanged.
